# systemd --user units enabled on this machine.
#
# These are NOT stowed. ~/.config/systemd/user/*.target.wants/ contains only
# symlinks into /usr/lib/systemd/user/, generated by `systemctl --user enable`.
# Stowing a symlink farm of symlinks is fragile and breaks when a package moves
# its unit file, so the enabled set is recorded here instead.
#
# Re-enable on a fresh machine:
#   grep -v '^#' meta/systemd-user-units.txt | xargs -r systemctl --user enable --now

arch-update-tray.service
arch-update.timer

# docker.socket here is the *user* socket: it activates the rootless
# docker.service that docker-rootless-extras ships, listening on
# $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock. Install the docker packages and the subuid /
# subgid ranges (see the README) before enabling it, or it fails to start.
docker.socket

# Deliberately not listed:
#   warp-taskbar.service - enabled on this machine, but not wanted on a
#     rebuild. Do not re-add it from a live `systemctl --user` listing.
